name: Piotr Müller - Après le § 64 - Am 25
title: REPORT on public procurement
part_text: Ba. whereas the European Court of Auditors has found that strategic procurement, despite its potential to advance social, environmental or innovation goals, has had a limited impact; whereas the social dimension of public procurement, including the horizontal social clause, should be strengthened as it cannot be sufficiently implemented in practice1a; whereas the revision process should reflect the principles of the European Pillar of Social Rights; \_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_ 1a European Court of Auditors, Special report 28/2023: Public procurement in the EU – Less competition for contracts awarded for works, goods and services in the 10 years up to 2021.
